replication.target_description: This effect examines whether grasp movements differ in execution time compared to ward movements. The target appears to be a main effect comparing grasp and ward/push execution times. The available excerpt reports stimulus-by-direction interactions and stimulus contrasts within directions, not a clearly identified main effect of direction. A complete report is unavailable locally, so absence from the full paper is not established.

n.sample_role: Candidate abstract count: 27 participants; target-test analytic inclusion unresolved.
n.exclusions: Excerpt reports 14.2 % erroneous trials, 3.3 % early movements and 2.5 SD outlier correction (1.83 % onset, 2.53 % contact, 2.57 % collection); one additional session cancelled. No N derived from these percentages or df.
